title: review-rust-code input
description: Input contract for the review-rust-code Review stage. Consumes the design plus the entire output of an upstream Rust Generate stage plus the file contents the workflow fetched. Validated by the workflow engine before invocation.

design_document.description: The same approved design document the upstream Generate stage consumed. Used at step 2 to extract the truth against which claims are checked.

target_crate.description: Same Rust crate path / module path the Generate stage targeted (e.g. 'services/payments', 'crates/payments/src/loan').

implement_stage_output.description: Verbatim output payload of the upstream Rust implement stage for this feature. Structure validated separately against that skill's schemas/output.json. See references/implement-stage-output-contract.md for the forward-compat extension keys (decision_metadata.rust_specific).

decision_metadata.description: Implement stage's decisions. The optional `rust_specific` block carries forward-compat extension keys consumed when present, ignored when absent. See references/implement-stage-output-contract.md.

rust_specific.description: Rust-implement-skill extension fields. Optional. Reviewer consumes when present, falls back to direct code walk when absent.

schema_version.description: e.g. '1.1-rust'. Bump major on field removal/type change; minor for additive fields.

unsafe_declarations.description: Per-unsafe-block records. Shape mirrors clippy --message-format=json diagnostics. See references/coverage-and-unsafe-shapes.md § Unsafe tracking.

async_runtime_features.description: Tokio (or chosen runtime) features required, e.g. ['tokio_rt_multi_thread', 'tokio_macros'].

per_function_coverage.description: Per-function coverage entries. Keys converged across cargo-llvm-cov / cargo-tarpaulin / LCOV. See references/coverage-and-unsafe-shapes.md § Coverage.

clippy_lint_floor.description: Free-text identifier; mirrors convention_overrides.lint_floor for cross-check.

code_under_review.description: Production files emitted by Generate (typically *.rs plus any Cargo.toml deltas). Each entry includes the file content so the reviewer can cite file:line.

tests_under_review.description: Companion tests emitted by Generate (#[cfg(test)] modules inline, integration tests under tests/*.rs, or doctests). Empty array is invalid - banking-grade never reviews production without companion tests.

idempotency_key.description: UUID v4 carried from the workflow. Same key + same other inputs MUST produce the same verdict bytes.

convention_overrides.description: Optional. Declares the repo's choice of crate / framework for each role so the reviewer evaluates rules against the actual stack instead of mis-flagging template defaults. Absent values mean the default crate applies (see references/review-checklist.md Convention overrides preamble for the defaults).

http_framework.description: Default: axum. Examples: actix-web, warp, rocket, poem, salvo.

sql_layer.description: Default: sqlx. Examples: diesel, sea-orm, tokio-postgres, rusqlite.

logging_crate.description: Default: tracing. Examples: slog, log+env_logger, log4rs.

error_crate.description: Default: thiserror for domain errors, anyhow at application top-level. Examples: eyre, miette, snafu.

validation_crate.description: Default: validator. Examples: garde, hand-rolled TryFrom<RawDto>.

lint_floor.description: Free-text identifier for the repo's lint baseline (e.g. 'workspace.lints with unsafe_code=forbid + clippy::pedantic warn').

forbid_under.description: Globset patterns (gitignore semantics). Files matching one of these are FORBID regardless of default. Restrictive wins over allow_under.

allow_under.description: Globset patterns. Files matching one of these are ALLOW (unless also matched by forbid_under).

expect_invariant_policy.description: Either a single string (allow|forbid applied to all files) or an object with per-path overrides via globset patterns. See references/severity-guide.md § Documented-invariant expect exception § Per-module override, and references/glob-policy-idioms.md for glob syntax.

severity_floor.description: Findings below this severity are dropped from the output. Default P3 (emit everything). Set P2 or P1 only for noisy reviews.

critical_paths.description: Per-path severity-zone declarations. When a finding's `file` matches one of the `globs`, severity is promoted to the declared `promote_to` (default P1) but only for eligible categories (data_correctness, idempotency, security, audit, compensation, async_blocking, unsafe_rust, cancellation, supply_chain). Cosmetic categories (observability, errors, scope, project_structure, cargo_hygiene, lint_baseline, claims_vs_reality, tests) are NOT promoted. Glob dialect: globset (gitignore semantics). See references/severity-guide.md § Critical-paths severity promotion and references/glob-policy-idioms.md.

reason.description: Human-readable rationale (money handling, auth boundary, PII handling, key material, etc.). Surfaces in finding evidence as '[critical: <reason>]'.

promote_to.description: Target severity for matching findings in eligible categories. Defaults to P1.
